status: frozen, conditional on the acquisition in evidence-acquisition-001.json; no rollout of this contract has run
frozen_before: any comparative answer; no working or changed deployment of the A1 policy exists yet

task.environment: robosuite 1.4.1 Lift, MuJoCo 3.2.7, controller OSC_POSE (checkpoint env_metadata), control frequency 20 Hz
task.success: cube body height exceeds table height plus 0.04 m (robosuite Lift._check_success), evaluated every step, rollout stops on success
task.executor: nisayon.engine.lift.LiftExecutor: single torch thread, deterministic algorithms, seeds 0..2^32-1, retained telemetry

policy.family: robomimic 0.3.0 BC-RNN low-dim trained with hdf5_normalize_obs true (path A1)
policy.identity_binding: checkpoint sha256, training config digest, dataset sha256 and robomimic/torch versions recorded at acquisition; the contract is void for any other checkpoint
policy.observation_dtype: float64 numpy observations from the simulator; RolloutPolicy._prepare_observation normalizes in float64 numpy first (ObsUtils.normalize_obs) and then converts to float32 tensors (TensorUtils.to_float); the reference must emulate that order
policy.action: 7 values in [-1,1]: OSC_POSE pose deltas scaled by output_max 0.05 m and 0.5 rad, gripper sign
policy.statistics_path: RolloutPolicy.obs_normalization_stats: per key mean and std, (obs - mean) / std with robomimic's normalize_obs; bound from ckpt_dict['obs_normalization_stats'] by policy_from_checkpoint

intervention.working: the checkpoint with the statistics it was trained with
intervention.changed: the same checkpoint with candidate statistics bound in ckpt_dict before policy_from_checkpoint; nothing else differs
candidates_scope: statistics of a different public release of the same task (if held)
statistics recomputed over a declared subset of demonstrations
the identity (no normalization) as the null candidate

distinctions.numeric_map_difference: on the working trajectory's recorded observations, replay both normalizers through the policy (teacher forced) and compare per-step actions; threshold max |delta action| > 0.01 in any pose coordinate or any gripper sign change; below threshold the change is numerically inert on that domain
distinctions.executed_action_difference: closed-loop rollouts of both deployments on the same seed diverge at the first step where the threshold is exceeded; the divergence step is recorded
distinctions.task_outcome_difference: the success indicator differs on a seed, or the step of success differs by more than 40 steps (10 percent of the horizon)
distinctions.valid_confirmed_repair: the arm's chosen operation, applied as a deployment, succeeds on every fresh confirmation seed on which the working deployment succeeds, with the confirmation seeds and rule declared here

trial_assignment.screening_role: exploratory; both deployments run; effects observed here never count as confirmation
trial_assignment.confirmation_role: fresh; run once per arm's chosen deployment after both arms have committed their decision
trial_assignment.retention: failed, cancelled, missing and unresolved rollouts stay in the assigned population and count against the arm

arms.nisayon: reference emulation of the robomimic normalizer plus the engine's keep/replace rule; may request up to 20 rollouts of screening seeds
arms.conventional: a separately authored float32-faithful workflow that recomputes the normalized observations and actions itself and decides keep/replace with its own rule; same 20-rollout budget, same evidence, same permissions
arms.shared: the executor, simulator, checkpoint bytes and telemetry are shared witnesses and are disclosed; decision code is not shared
arms.independence_limit: both arms are written in this repository by the two lanes; model-session separation is not empirical independence

endpoint.primary: decision quality at the equal rollout budget: for each candidate, an arm is correct when its keep/replace/abstain matches the confirmation outcome (replace supported only if the changed deployment passes the confirmation rule; keep supported only if the changed deployment fails it; abstain is never correct when the confirmation resolves)
endpoint.secondary: complete cost per arm: rollouts requested, wall and CPU of decision computation, retries, storage; shared acquisition, training and setup costs reported separately and not divided
endpoint.undefined: cost per confirmed repair when there is no confirmed repair

thresholds_basis: 0.01 normalized action equals 0.5 mm or 5 mrad of commanded delta per step, below which the OSC controller's response is within its steady-state error; 40 steps is 2 s at 20 Hz; both set from the task semantics before any result

resource_ceilings.rollouts_total: at most 60 (20 per arm screening, 20 confirmation)
resource_ceilings.process_cpu_seconds: at most 1800 for rollouts plus 120 per lane for diagnostics
resource_ceilings.artifacts: within the 16 MiB durable phase cap; the telemetry profile and checkpoint retention plan must be declared and sized before the first rollout (earlier full-profile Lift telemetry was about 77 MiB for 69 rollouts)

stopping_rule: stop after the confirmation seeds for both arms' chosen deployments have run once; a tie or a failed candidate is a valid outcome; no candidate is added after outcomes are seen
exposure: the remedy class (keep the training statistics) is known to both lanes; the study is labelled exposed and is not a blinded repair discovery
void_if: the policy is not the one bound at acquisition
the changed deployment differs in anything but the bound statistics
a seed is replaced after it has run

amendments.change: observation_dtype now states that normalization runs in float64 numpy before the float32 conversion, as read in robomimic 0.3.0 algo.py _prepare_observation
amendments.effect: none on thresholds, seeds, arms or endpoints

amendments.change: the run requires an exact telemetry and checkpoint size plan within the 16 MiB durable phase cap (or a raised cap) and license evidence for the dataset and executed checkpoint, both declared before the first rollout
amendments.effect: none on thresholds, seeds, arms or endpoints
